title: Generalized almost disjoint families and injective Banach spaces
summary: A fundamental open problem in the homological theory of Banach spaces is the calculation of the injective dimension of the Banach space $c_0$. We make a contribution to the study of this problem by proving that, if the Continuum Hypothesis ($\mathsf{CH}$) holds, then the injective dimension of $c_0$ is at least 3. In the course of proving this result, we introduce the notion of an \emph{almost disjoint family} on a topological space $X$, generalizing the classical notion of almost disjoint families of subsets of $\mathbb{N}$, which we feel is of interest in its own right.
